notes: Systemic: all 41 UN R records have ~190-250 char link-only stub bodies (precheck body-thin), so the UI's 'full text' claim is false for them; summaries are mostly title-restating and several are AI hedging ('provided text contains insufficient detail') - low-value text. All source_url point to the generic WP.29 Regulations index, not the specific regulation page. un_equivalent fields are empty (appropriate, since these are UN regs themselves). Titles/citations checked against known UN R subjects (R3,4,6,7,19,23,37,38,45,48,77,87,91,98,99 lighting; R162 immobilisers; R163 alarm systems; R168 RDE; R17/25/21/26/34/43/94/95/44 safety) and all match; none are withdrawn.
